التحقن (form VIII)
# اِلْتَحَقْنَ (iltaḥaqna) /il.ta.ħaq.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِلْتَحَقَ (iltaḥaqa)
# اُلْتُحِقْنَ (ultuḥiqna) /ul.tu.ħiq.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِلْتَحَقَ (iltaḥaqa)
# اِلْتَحِقْنَ (iltaḥiqna) /il.ta.ħiq.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِلْتَحَقَ (iltaḥaqa)
